info.name: Logto Mock API v1.23.0
info.description:
Test collection for the mock Logto service. Base URL defaults to http://localhost:8116. In docker-compose, the service is reachable at http://logto-api:8116.

Logto is OIDC-first, and the collection is built around that. `/oidc/*` is a real OAuth 2.0 authorization server: `POST /oidc/token` takes a grant_type (authorization_code, refresh_token, client_credentials), a `resource` indicator and a `scope`, and mints an access token bound to that resource. Errors follow RFC 6749.

`/api/*` is the Management API, which is itself just another protected resource. A bearer works there only if it was issued FOR https://default.logto.app/api and carries a wide enough scope. The collection sends the same `GET /api/users` with four different tokens to show the four answers: full management token (200), read-only management token (200 for reads, 403 for writes), a token minted for the Orbit Status API (403, wrong audience) and an organization token (403).

Seeded tokens: full management `logto_at_ci_full_9f14c73e0b2a`, read-only `logto_at_reporting_ro_5b07d21f8c64`, status-API `logto_at_amelia_status_c8e05a1976b3`, organization `logto_at_amelia_org_platform_7a63f04c9e21`. Requests labelled '(N expected)' assert an error path.
